problem_statement: Build a brand-new Reports page from scratch at the /reports route of this Material Tailwind dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the dashboard home. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (sidebar + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Material Tailwind design system (Card, CardHeader gradient, Typography, Button, Chip, the blue-gray color tokens). The page must present a period toggle (Weekly / Monthly / Yearly) that actually drives the content: switching the period must swap the KPI figures, the traffic-channels table rows, and the visible period heading. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A Reports Overview card header styled like the other dashboard cards (gradient header, white title text)
A period toggle group with three options labelled Weekly, Monthly and Yearly
A prominent period heading that names the currently selected period (e.g. 'Monthly Performance Summary')
A row of four KPI summary cards (Revenue, New Users, Sessions, Conversion) each showing a value and a delta chip
A 'Top Traffic Channels' table listing channels with visits, share % and a rising/falling trend chip
Clicking a different period option re-renders the KPI values, the channels table and the period heading to that period's data
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages

The period heading reads exactly '<Period> Performance Summary' (e.g. 'Monthly Performance Summary', 'Yearly Performance Summary'); render it as a prominent heading (any h1-h4 heading tag is acceptable).
The four KPI card labels are exactly 'Revenue', 'New Users', 'Sessions' and 'Conversion'.
design_constraints: Reuse Material Tailwind components already used by the dashboard (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, Typography, Button, Chip)
Keep the site's blue-gray color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing dashboard layout chrome (Sidenav, DashboardNavbar, Footer)

Use the dashboard's blue-gray palette tokens: primary/body text blue-gray-500 rgb(96,125,139) (#607D8B) and blue-gray-600 rgb(84,110,122) (#546E7A), dark headings blue-gray-900 rgb(38,50,56) (#263238), page background white rgb(255,255,255) with a gray gradient CardHeader; font family Roboto, sans-serif. Do not introduce colors outside this blue-gray/white system.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /reports 是空 route (element={<></>}), 走不到 catch-all 重定向; reference 完整实现 period 切换; bad 移除 Button onClick 使切换失灵(渲染正常但点击不改 DOM)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。route 挂在 BrowserRouter basename=/material-tailwind-dashboard-react 下, 故 state_plan path 为 /material-tailwind-dashboard-react/reports。
